reported_hunters_finds.verified_sample: https://storage.googleapis.com/uclabruins-com-prod/2026/05/21/hmApaW0edf4pNF0N3pjaWJS9ikCDdEgssBGQ8Esj.pdf (linked from the 1974-75 season's 'Box Scores (PDF)' entry) — fetched and confirmed an 'OFFICIAL NCAA BASKETBALL BOX SCORE' for the Dec 21, 1974 UCLA vs Notre Dame game (Dantley's 30-point game) with full per-player lines.
reported_hunters_finds.coverage_claim: Official UCLA Bruins Athletics archive page has a 'Box Scores (PDF)' link for every season continuously from 1974-75 through 2001-02 (28 pre-2002 seasons), and continuing to present. Seasons 1947-48 through 1973-74 only have 'Statistics (PDF)' (season cumulative totals, verified format below) and 'Roster (PDF)' — no per-game box scores for that earlier span.
reported_hunters_finds.notes: IMPORTANT IMPLEMENTATION NOTE: the '/documents/{uuid}.pdf' URLs on the page are NOT the real PDFs — they return an HTML wrapper page (SPA shell, content-type text/html) with a `<object data="https://storage.googleapis.com/uclabruins-com-prod/...">` tag pointing to the actual PDF on Google Cloud Storage. You must fetch the wrapper HTML first, extract the storage.googleapis.com URL, then fetch that for the real PDF. Each season's 'Box Scores (PDF)' appears to be ONE PDF containing box scores for every game that season (verified doc for 1974-75 was multi-page with the Notre Dame game as page 1). Also note: the 'Statistics (PDF)' links (present for all seasons back to the 1930s/40s) are season-total stat sheets only, not per-game — do not confuse with box scores when scraping.

reported_hunters_finds.verified_sample: https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/images/2018/07/1928-29.pdf (game vs Ohio Wesleyan, Dec 8, 1928) - fetched and read the actual PDF
reported_hunters_finds.coverage_claim: Full season-by-season scanned box score PDFs linked from https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/sports/2023/6/5/mens-basketball-all-time-box-scores (aka mens-basketball-all-time-box-scores page), starting with the 1920s (earliest verified: 1928-29 season) and continuing through every season up to present (2025-26). One PDF per season containing every game played that year.
fields_seen: team score, opponent, date, attendance, captain, manager, referee/umpire/timer for many games
reported_hunters_finds.notes: This is a scanned typed-scoresheet format (per-game 'Form 3130' summary sheets), not OCR text -- images embedded in PDF. Verified 4 pages covering 4 different 1928-29 games (vs Ohio Wesleyan, Penn, Pittsburgh, North Carolina), all with complete two-team player-by-player box scores. URL pattern for each season's PDF is https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/images/{upload-date-path}/{season}.pdf, e.g. 1928-29.pdf, 1929-30.pdf, ... found by scraping the all-time-box-scores landing page HTML (the page is JS-rendered; needed to fetch raw HTML via curl and grep for href= links, not WebFetch which only sees the rendered title). This is very likely the single richest verified pre-2002 box-score source found across all 36 programs and is a strong Ohio State-only lead worth a dedicated deeper scrape (17-page PDFs per season, one game per page, going back to 1928).

reported_hunters_finds.verified_sample: Fetched via live browser (direct curl/WebFetch blocked by anti-bot JS challenge, HTTP 418): item 'ark:/87278/...' details page id=1251154, '1972.12.23 University of Louisville vs. University of Utah' men's basketball gamebook, and id=1255377 (1992 women's game, same format). Full-page screenshot of page 1 shows a handwritten scorer's sheet.
reported_hunters_finds.coverage_claim: Men's basketball 'gamebook' PDFs exist per-game at least from the 1966-67 season through the mid-2010s (verified season listings for 1966-67: 25 games; 1972-73: 28 games, both men's). Search UI: https://collections.lib.utah.edu/search?q=(SEASON)+AND+(men's+Basketball)+AND+subject_t:(game+book)
reported_hunters_finds.notes: Real per-player, per-game scanned scorer's sheets, same genre as the Louisville scanned-sheet archive already ingested. Site is protected by a JS bot-challenge (curl/WebFetch get HTTP 418 'I'm a teapot' on the /search, /details, and /file?id= endpoints) so a scraping script will need a headless-browser or challenge-solving approach, not plain HTTP. Direct file route once past the challenge is /file?id={itemId}. Item metadata (opponent, date, final score, season) is in the page's description fields, useful for indexing before bulk download. Also found on the same directory page: media guides (recent years only, not historical) and a 'Basketball Video Collection, 1906-1969' at Marriott Library Special Collections (not fetched/verified — video, not box scores).
